title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Cardmember Agreement: Annual Fee and Foreign Transaction Fee
content:
**Annual fee.** The annual fee on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account is the card's annual fee, billed on the statement whose billing period contains the anniversary of the account's opened date. It is not billed on a card whose annual fee is 0.00, not billed for the first card year when the card waives the first year, and not billed when the card-year spend for the card year just ended reaches the card's waiver spend. The card-year spend is all purchases charged to the account (all merchants) by transaction date in the card year ending the day before the anniversary of the opened date, less the merchandise credits posted in that card year.

**Foreign transaction fee.** The foreign transaction fee is the card's foreign transaction fee percent of a purchase made in a foreign currency or processed outside the United States, rounded half up to the cent, pointing to that purchase by its transaction reference; a card whose percent is 0.00 or not applicable charges none.

**Expedited replacement fee.** The expedited replacement fee is governed by the replacement card terms.

## Annual fee cases (hypothetical card: annual fee USD 79.00, first year waived, waiver spend USD 15000.00)

| Anniversary | Card-year spend for the year just ended | Annual fee billed |
|---|---|---|
| first anniversary (end of the first card year) | any | no, the first year is waived |
| second anniversary | USD 16200.00 purchases less USD 900.00 credits, USD 15300.00 | no |
| second anniversary | USD 14000.00 | USD 79.00 |

## Foreign fee in figures (hypothetical 3 percent card)

| Foreign purchase | Fee found | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| USD 123.45 | 3.7035 | USD 3.70 |
| USD 250.50 | 7.515 | USD 7.52 |

On a card whose percent is 0.00, or a store-only card, no foreign transaction fee is charged.
